Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards I reveal with this card's effect include only an [Argomon] or [Rhythm], can I just add that 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both an [Argomon] and [Rhythm], can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Argomon] and 1 [Rhythm] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
